questions.contextText: Summary of Passage (Q.24–30): People frequently wear earphones on busy streets, vehicles, and at work for personal entertainment, which can create risky or awkward incidents. The narrator describes an electrician who failed to repair a water pump properly because wearing earphones prevented him from hearing the instructions clearly. On another occasion aboard the Konark Express near Kalupada Ghat, the narrator spotted an unattended large bag under a berth and feared it contained a bomb, until its young owner—who had been leaning by the door with earphones on—came to collect it. The writer warns that using earphones while walking or driving diverts attention from personal safety and causes absentmindedness, concluding that giving in to any addiction degrades quality of life.
